statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is at the top of the low band and remains below the WATCH threshold, while Stress sits in the elevated band on a 10-year yield near one-year highs, live 50% US tariffs on selected Canadian goods, and an Asian tech rout led by Samsung and Alibaba.
recommendation: Descriptive: NQ futures at 29,142.50 (-0.83%) are holding near the 29,120.50 overnight low after a persistent Asian-session drift, but ES (-0.22%) and YM (-0.04%) show the weakness is tech-specific rather than broad risk-off, and VIX at 14.89 shows no volatility-regime shift. The narrow mapped danger window spans the 13:30Z US cash open through 14:30Z, where first-hour retracement quality is the decisive evidence.
headline: Nasdaq-100: tech-led overnight drift near session lows; Stress elevated on yields and tariffs, Tail stays sub-block
body: NQ futures trade at 29,142.50, down 0.83% from a 29,387.75 prior close, inside a 29,120.50-29,297.00 overnight range and close to its low. The decline built progressively through Asian hours, from about -0.3% at 00:35Z, which is genuine directional structure rather than a single gap. The proximate drivers are single-name: Samsung Electronics fell 8.7% after a capital-return plan that lacked a buyback and treasury-share cancellation timetable, and Alibaba fell roughly 10% after pricing an HK$80bn share placement at an 8.4% discount to fund AI infrastructure. Kospi closed down 3.5%, Hang Seng down 2.1%, Nikkei down 0.5% and Shanghai down 0.7%, while Australia's ASX 200 rose 0.5%. Cross-asset confirmation is incomplete: ES is down only 0.22% and YM 0.04%, VIX closed Friday at 14.89 after a 6.0% decline, and WTI is down about 2.1% near $85.2 with Brent near $92.9, which is a disinflationary offset rather than a risk-off amplifier. The macro backdrop is the more material stress channel. The 10-year Treasury yield was near 4.71% early Monday after reaching roughly 4.73% on Friday, its highest in more than a year, and the 30-year sits near its highest since 2007 after spiking to 5.267% on 20 August when the Treasury's doubled long-bond buybacks failed to hold. The 2-year was 4.19% in the latest H.15 release. Separately, 50% US tariffs on about $20bn of Canadian goods, roughly 5% of Canada's exports to the US, took effect on 22 August after talks collapsed, with Canadian dollar-for-dollar retaliation scheduled for 8 September. Taken together these are multiple independent stress amplifiers, but the observed NQ price path is a contained 0.6% overnight range with a modest total decline, which does not yet meet the standard for persistent mean-reversion failure. Tail is therefore held at the top of the low band while Stress is raised into the elevated band. The decisive evidence checkpoint is the 13:30Z US cash open, where the Asian tech move, the live tariffs and the long-end yield backdrop all reprice into US liquidity simultaneously; first-hour retracement depth will determine whether the overnight drift is corrective or the start of persistent directional efficiency. Wednesday carries the heaviest catalyst stack of the week with Core PCE, the second GDP estimate and durable goods at 12:30Z and NVIDIA reporting after the US close, followed by Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote on Friday at 14:00Z.

lookbackSummary: Over the prior 24 clock-hours the published Claude series stayed green with EA_ON throughout, Tail between 4 and 15 and Stress between 34 and 46. Tail was 4 for most of the 23 August European and US session, briefly reached 15 at 22:00Z, then settled into a 7-12 band overnight before the 06:00Z reading lifted Stress to 46. Four hours (07:00Z, 10:00Z, 11:00Z and 12:00Z on 23 August) have no published assessment and are marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The 24-hour path holds Tail in the low band and EA_ON for every hour except the 13:00Z and 14:00Z US cash-open window, where conditional Tail steps to 21 and maps to WATCH. Stress stays in the elevated band throughout, peaking at 61 during the opening hour and easing to the high-40s overnight. Conditional risk decays through the US afternoon on the assumption of orderly price discovery, with the Bessent speech at 18:00Z and the 20:00Z cash close as secondary checkpoints, and rises marginally into Tuesday's European pre-open as Wednesday's Core PCE and NVIDIA catalyst stack approaches.
